recommendedProtocol: powershell -NoProfile -Command, pinned probe source as one argv, shell omitted/false
requiredImplementationConstraints: Original pinned probe script remains exactly the original source with only the Running rejection term removed; no progress/error stream filtering.
Keep return code zero, bytes stdout, valid complete JSON and empty stderr mandatory.
Complete probe metadata may be Running or Ready only; exact identity, enabled principal fields, full XML and unique ACL validation remain.
A copied Running value is normalized only to compare against the one persistent expected anchor; Ready is compared without state change.
Probe Ready never returns or archives a probe object. It only permits another original strict snapshot inside the remaining deadline.
Only a subsequent actual original strict Ready snapshot matching the anchor may return. Initial prepare without expected digest must preserve one anchor and still pass the durable V2 prior-host gate.
Original second-message failed response still must be a valid Running response; wrong identity/disabled/other states cannot be excused by a later probe.
Keep monotonic total 45-second budget including source verification, original strict, probe and sleeps.
V4 must use a unique pinned module name and the same name/path/hash/exact-class checks for safe error codes, with no V3 fallback.
Keep archive raw-byte gate, original mutation sequence, CAS, V1/V2/V3 sources/reservations/failures unchanged.
